lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in three primary horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular 2D grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal ridges, with white spots located at the centers of the resulting rectangular grid cells.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges run horizontally across the upper and middle flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light upper edge to a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of four remoras (Echeneidae) trailing the ventral and posterior margins of the right pectoral fin.
